comments: Tommy announces two big changes to the FRS format from this show; the end of the rock chart rundown, and also the end of the Friday Night Connection which will be replaced by the Lie Back And Enjoy It segment.
Tommy threatens to defect to Radio Two if he doesn't win the Sounds Best DJ award next year! (He was runner up to John Peel for 1984).

sessions.details: first broadcast. Simon Wake (vocals), Phil Ball (keyboards), Shaun Wilmslow (guitar), Adam Smallman (drums), Mark Davis (bass).
